value.rationale: Complete group-symmetry refinement of a canonical strongly regular graph complex, from a natural action rather than an arbitrary finite parameter slice. Gives 2-dimensional translation-invariant rational top homology and three extra 2-dimensional rational representations invisible to the already known 23-sphere wedge and to spectral parameters. Natural independent-set parallel classes explain exceptional traces and the result is suitable for equivariant graph-topology comparisons.
